fields.description: Circle is a mixed-use tower in Jumeirah Village Circle, combining studios and one- to three-bedroom apartments with offices and ground-floor retail. Its curved floor plate creates a series of outward-facing balcony plans. The residential catalogue is kept distinct from commercial accommodation and changing sale availability.

overview: Compare the exact plan and orientation rather than a tower-wide view claim. Office and retail counts describe the mixed-use development, while residential enquiries must identify a specific apartment type and floor.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai; Property Finder places Circle in District 13. Exact plot access and apartment outlook should be checked before relying on map or skyline illustrations.
research.priceNote: The own hero displays FROM AED 674999. Property Finder gives a rounded 675,000 launch reference, marks developer homes sold out, and retains an inconsistent 1,080,000 FAQ figure. No listed minimum is treated as confirmed current Aliyas inventory or a binding price.
research.paymentNote: The own FAQ states 20% on contract signing, 50% during construction and 30% on completion. Property Finder also lists a 10/40/50 alternative and 20/50/30 variants with different instalment counts. These are distinct published offers; no dated unit schedule or outstanding balance was retrieved.
research.handoverNote: The developer targets Q2 2027, while Property Finder gives May 2027 within that quarter. These are forecast references rather than proof of completed works or an unconditional unit handover promise.

facts.label: Original mixed-use schedule
facts.value: 776 residences:250 studios, 504 one-bedroom, 16 two-bedroom and 6 three-bedroom apartments; 31 offices and 15 shops. Not a current inventory statement.

facts.label: Vertical components
facts.value: Own facts list 2 basements, ground, 4 podiums, 58 floors, 3 mechanical levels, 3 STR levels and roof. The abbreviation STR is not expanded into an assumed residential use.

unresolved: Current developer/resale availability, service charges, parking allocation, furnishings and dated payment obligations require selected-unit confirmation. No construction-progress percentage is invented.
Total areas include balconies and are published plan examples. Actual suite dimensions, orientation, equipment and finishes must be checked against the selected sale agreement.
The developer’s tallest-in-JVC description is marketing language, not an independently verified permanent ranking; it is not adopted as a guaranteed fact.
